title: AGENT GYM: Evaluating and Training Large Language Model-based Agents across Diverse Environments
authors_zh: Zhiheng Xi, Yiwen Ding, Wenxiang Chen, Boyang Hong, Honglin Guo, Junzhe Wang, Xin Guo, Dingwen Yang, Chenyang Liao, Wei He, Songyang Gao, Lu Chen, Rui Zheng, Yicheng Zou, Tao Gui, Qi Zhang, Xipeng Qiu, Xuanjing Huang, Zuxuan Wu, Yu-Gang Jiang
paper_type_zh: 跨环境代理轨迹数据集与交互训练框架研究

one_line: AgentTraj-L releases 14,485 reward-filtered ReAct demonstrations from 11 interactive environments for cross-environment agent SFT.
AgentTraj-L 公开来自十一个交互环境的 14,485 条奖励过滤示范，用于跨环境代理监督微调。
why: It pairs static trainable traces with standardized live environments, making reward provenance and cross-environment comparisons unusually explicit.
inclusion_reason: AgentTraj-L releases 14,485 reward-filtered ReAct demonstrations from 11 interactive environments for cross-environment agent SFT.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Primary source: ACL 2025 long paper, published 27 July--1 August 2025. The decision boundary is the released AgentTraj-L demonstration corpus, not AgentGym as infrastructure and not the paper's later online-RL outcomes. AgentTraj-L qualifies because it exposes complete thought-action-observation episodes filtered by native environmental feedback and directly consumed by SFT.

The concrete problem is that agent training corpora usually bind to one environment and cannot be compared under a consistent interface. AgentGym unifies 14 environments and constructs 14,485 high-reward demonstrations from 11 of them; the data object is the static episode, and the evaluation surface is AgentEval plus per-environment success or reward. Atlas relevance is the link between heterogeneous reward-filtered traces and a controlled SFT consumer.

L4 facts: ACL acceptance, 14 environments, 89 task types, 20,494 instructions, 1,160 evaluation cases, 14,485 AgentTraj-L episodes, reward filtering, public access, and missing dataset-license declaration were verified.

主要来源是 2025 年 7 月 27 日至 8 月 1 日举行的 ACL 2025 长文。筛选边界是公开的 AgentTraj-L 示范语料，而不是把 AgentGym 基础设施本身或后续在线强化学习结果当成主体。AgentTraj-L 发布完整的思考、动作与观察回合，以原生环境反馈过滤并直接供监督微调使用，因此符合收录范围。

它要解决的具体问题是，代理训练语料通常绑定单一环境，难以在一致接口下比较。AgentGym 统一十四个环境，并从其中十一个环境构造 14,485 条高奖励示范；数据对象是静态回合，评测面是 AgentEval 和各环境的成功率或奖励。对图谱而言，关键价值是把异构奖励过滤轨迹与可控监督训练消费连接起来。

L4 事实：已核对 ACL 接收、十四个环境、八十九类任务、20,494 条指令、1,160 个评测样本、14,485 条 AgentTraj-L 回合、奖励过滤、公开访问，以及数据集未声明专用许可。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The contribution is a gather-and-filter pipeline that converts heterogeneous live environments into a common pool of successful ReAct demonstrations. Existing traces or rule-solvable paths receive added thoughts, while other paths come from commercial-model exploration or crowdsourcing; environment reward is the feedback contract. The category rationale is direct: the released rows supervise intermediate thoughts and actions in SFT. AgentInstruct and AGENT BANK are the closest data comparisons, while AgentBench is mainly an evaluation comparison.

Open dataset: Yes Dataset name: AgentTraj-L Official URL: https://huggingface.co/datasets/AgentGym/AgentTraj-L Scale: 14,485 high-quality trajectories across 11 environments, within a 14-environment framework Record form: Multi-turn instruction, thought, action, observation, and reward episode File / storage format: Public Hugging Face dataset files with environment-specific records Domains / languages: English web navigation, text games, embodied tasks, tools, and programming Construction and filtering: Rule/human traces with added thoughts or model/crowd exploration, followed by reward and correctness filtering License / access constraints: Non-gated public access; no dedicated dataset license declared, while code is MIT Intended use: Cross-environment agent SFT and controlled comparison with reward-based self-improvement

核心贡献是一条汇集与过滤流水线，把异构实时环境转成统一的成功推理动作示范池。已有过程或可由规则求解的路径会补写思考，其余路径来自商用模型探索或众包；环境奖励构成反馈契约。分类理由很直接：发布记录在监督微调中训练中间思考与动作。最接近的数据对比是 AgentInstruct 和 AGENT BANK，AgentBench 则主要属于评测对比。

title: Method
方法
html:
Step 1 -- Standardize interactive environments. Input: Fourteen environments with incompatible dependencies, actions, and rewards. Operation: Deploy each as a service behind create, reset, observation, available-action, and step interfaces. Output and transition: Reproducible environment endpoints enter instruction collection. Check / stop rule: Each service must reset, expose legal actions, execute a step, and return an observation or reward.

Step 2 -- Build instruction and evaluation pools. Input: Original task splits, rule generators, and examples for model-based expansion. Operation: Gather or generate 20,494 instructions, manually verify model-generated tasks, and reserve 1,160 cases for AgentEval. Output and transition: Feasible training instructions enter trajectory collection. Check / stop rule: Reject generated instructions that cannot be completed in the target environment.

Step 3 -- Gather and filter demonstrations. Input: Instructions, rule/human action sequences, GPT-4-Turbo, crowdsourcing, and live environments. Operation: Add stepwise thoughts to known paths or explore unknown paths, execute every episode, and filter by reward and correctness. Output and transition: 14,485 AgentTraj-L episodes from 11 environments enter SFT. Check / stop rule: Retain only trajectories meeting the environment-specific success or reward condition.

Step 4 -- Supervise and compare agents. Input: Llama-2-Chat-7B and either 6,130 AgentTraj or 14,485 AgentTraj-L demonstrations. Operation: Run three-epoch trajectory SFT and evaluate all supported AgentEval environments. Output and transition: Comparable base agents and a trajectory-scale comparison. Check / stop rule: Report every environment metric; do not collapse incompatible rewards into an unexplained universal label.

Reproduction requires pinned environment images, seeds, instruction generators, teacher versions, crowdsourcing protocol, reward code, train/eval splits, dataset revision, and SFT settings. A complete collection-cost ledger is missing.

步骤 1——标准化交互环境。 输入：依赖、动作与奖励彼此不兼容的十四个环境。 操作：把每个环境独立部署为服务，并统一创建、重置、观察、可用动作和执行接口。 输出并进入下一步：可复现的环境端点进入指令收集。 检查与停止规则：每个服务都必须能重置、给出合法动作、执行一步并返回观察或奖励。

步骤 2——建立指令与评测池。 输入：原始任务划分、规则生成器，以及供模型扩展的示例。 操作：汇集或生成 20,494 条指令，人工检查模型生成任务，并保留 1,160 条作为 AgentEval。 输出并进入下一步：可在环境中完成的训练指令进入轨迹收集。 检查与停止规则：无法在目标环境完成的生成指令一律拒绝。

步骤 3——汇集并过滤示范。 输入：指令、规则或人工动作序列、教师模型、众包和实时环境。 操作：为已知路径逐步补写思考，或对未知路径进行探索；执行每个回合并按奖励与正确性过滤。 输出并进入下一步：来自十一个环境的 14,485 条 AgentTraj-L 回合进入监督训练。 检查与停止规则：只保留满足环境特定成功或奖励条件的轨迹。

步骤 4——监督训练并比较代理。 输入：Llama-2-Chat-7B，以及 6,130 条基础轨迹或 14,485 条大规模轨迹。 操作：进行三轮轨迹监督微调，并在所有支持的 AgentEval 环境上评测。 输出并进入下一步：得到可比较的基础代理和轨迹规模对照。 检查与停止规则：报告每个环境指标，不能把不兼容的奖励压成没有解释的通用标签。

复现需要固定环境镜像、随机种子、指令生成器、教师版本、众包流程、奖励代码、训练评测划分、数据修订版和监督训练设置。论文缺少完整的收集成本账本。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The decisive static-data comparison holds Llama-2-Chat-7B and the SFT recipe while replacing 6,130 AgentTraj episodes with 14,485 AgentTraj-L episodes. WebShop rises from 66.5 to 73.5, ALFWorld from 77.5 to 83.0, TextCraft from 44.0 to 60.0, and SciWorld from 26.42 to 74.47 (Table 3). The larger pool wins broadly, though source coverage and episode count change together.

AgentTraj-L-SFT also exceeds the untrained base by large margins across the supported tasks and is competitive with commercial agents on several environments. This confirms that the released demonstrations are consumable, but the broader paper's AgentSTaR results use additional exploration and should not be attributed to AgentTraj-L alone.

决定性的静态数据对照固定 Llama-2-Chat-7B 和监督训练方法，只把 6,130 条基础轨迹替换为 14,485 条大规模轨迹。WebShop 从 66.5 升到 73.5，ALFWorld 从 77.5 升到 83.0，TextCraft 从 44.0 升到 60.0，SciWorld 从 26.42 升到 74.47，见表 3。大数据池普遍占优，但来源覆盖和回合数量同时发生了变化。

大规模轨迹监督模型在多个支持任务上也显著超过未训练底座，并在若干环境接近商用代理。这证明发布示范能够被训练消费；不过论文中的 AgentSTaR 还使用额外探索，不能把其结果只归因于 AgentTraj-L。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Earlier agent datasets provide static demonstrations, and earlier benchmarks provide multiple evaluation environments, but the two surfaces are often disconnected. AgentGym changes this by exposing a common live interface together with reward-filtered SFT episodes and a matched evaluation suite. The direction signal is that data provenance can include executable environment contracts, not just text files. ReAct formatting, GPT-added rationales, SFT, and the underlying environments are inherited components.
早期代理数据集提供静态示范，早期基准提供多个评测环境，但两者往往相互脱节。AgentGym 的变化是同时开放统一实时接口、奖励过滤的监督回合和匹配评测集。它给出的方向信号是，数据血缘可以包含可执行环境契约，而不只是文本文件。思考动作格式、教师补写理由、监督训练和底层环境都属于继承组件。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Eleven environments contribute training episodes, and their reward scales and stopping rules are not interchangeable. Reuse should preserve environment-specific metrics and sampling weights.
  1. Success filtering creates teacher and difficulty selection bias, while generated thoughts may be post-hoc. Reuse should retain failures for audit and compare thought-free targets.
  1. The public dataset lacks a dedicated license declaration. Redistribution should be reviewed against the repository and every inherited environment or task source.

1. 实际提供训练回合的是十一个环境，其奖励尺度和停止条件不可互换。复用时应保留环境特定指标与采样权重。
  1. 成功过滤会带来教师与难度选择偏差，补写思考也可能是事后解释。复用时应保留失败记录供审计，并比较不含思考的训练目标。
  1. 公开数据没有专用许可声明。再分发前应同时检查代码仓库和每个继承环境或任务来源的条款。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
• For cross-environment SFT, preserve the environment ID, reward predicate, and action schema beside every trajectory. Success means improvement on held-out tasks without one large source dominating the mixture.
  • For infrastructure-aware curation, replay sampled episodes through the standardized services before training. The output is an executable-data audit; environments that cannot be pinned should be marked non-reproducible.

• 用于跨环境监督训练时，应在每条轨迹旁保留环境编号、奖励判据和动作模式。成功标准是在留出任务上提升，同时避免一个大来源支配混合。
  • 用于基础设施感知的数据策展时，应在训练前通过统一服务重放抽样回合。产物是可执行数据审计；无法固定版本的环境应标为不可复现。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Keep AgentTraj-L distinct from the smaller AgentTraj and from online AgentSTaR rollouts.
  2. Read Table 2 for per-environment counts; the 14,485 total is highly uneven.
  3. Treat reward as environment-specific metadata, not a globally calibrated score.
  4. Verify whether an episode's thought was original, added to a known path, or produced during exploration.
  5. Audit dataset terms separately from the MIT code license.

1. 区分 AgentTraj-L、较小的 AgentTraj 和在线 AgentSTaR 回合。
  2. 阅读表 2 的逐环境数量；14,485 条并非均匀分布。
  3. 把奖励视为环境特定元数据，而不是全局校准分数。
  4. 核实每条思考是原生记录、对已知路径的补写，还是探索时生成。
  5. 数据条款必须与 MIT 代码许可分开审计。

value.html: 20,494 gathered, rule-generated, or model-generated instructions across 14 interactive environments and 89 task types.
ReAct-style episodes containing task instruction, thought, environment action, observation, and terminal reward.
Rule solvers and human traces provide some actions; GPT-4-Turbo adds thoughts or explores, with crowdsourcing for selected environments.
Fourteen separately deployed environments behind standardized create, reset, observation, available-action, and step interfaces.
Environment-specific success rates or numeric rewards filter completed trajectories.
Retain trajectories that pass reward and correctness filtering; the public AgentTraj-L set represents the larger high-quality SFT pool.
Llama-2-Chat 7B for the main trajectory SFT comparison
GPT-4-Turbo, rule solvers, existing human traces, and crowdsourced annotators
Gather-and-filter collection over unified live environments, with rule-based or model-based instruction expansion.
Expand from 6,130 AgentTraj demonstrations to 14,485 AgentTraj-L demonstrations across 11 trainable environments.
Execute trajectories and filter by task reward and correctness; manually verify model-generated instructions for feasibility.
The paper reports environment and training hardware details but no complete teacher-call or collection-cost ledger.
Three-epoch SFT on collected trajectories; the broader paper also studies online and offline reward-based improvement.
AgentTraj-L contains 14,485 trajectories from 11 of 14 environments; WebShop, ALFWorld, SciWorld, and BIRD are the largest components.
AgentEval contains 1,160 evaluation instructions; train and evaluation pools are sampled or inherited per environment.
No unified semantic decontamination audit across all inherited and generated instructions is reported.

items: Reward functions and action semantics differ sharply across environments.
Successful trajectories can overrepresent easy instances and teacher-specific styles.
The absence of a dedicated dataset license complicates redistribution decisions.

value.html: The dataset page does not declare a dedicated data license; the associated AgentGym repository is MIT licensed and upstream environments retain their own terms.
